apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
# Added

* JIT. Please keep SideInstaller in the background to keep JIT running
* Sources. Add an AltStore-format source as an https link, an altstore:// or sidestore:// link, or a .json file. Thanks to @TinusTK (#143).
* Shortcuts actions, such as location spoofing, app installing and app refreshing.
* Pairing compatibility with ARMSX3


# Fixed

* Sign-in reports a current Mac again. 2.1.1 signed in as a Mac on macOS 10.15.7. Apple sometimes answers that Mac with a text-message code it never sends, or with -22410 or -23782. SideInstaller now signs in as the macOS 26.6 Mac it used up to 2.1.0, spelled \"Mac OS X\", and that Mac gets the code on trusted devices. The first sign-in with a password makes a new anisette identity, so Apple may ask for a code one more time.
* SideStore gets client info Apple lets through. Since 20 November Apple has answered SideStore's default client info with HTTP 503 (SideStore #1745). After installing SideStore, SideInstaller now sets it to the same Mac, spelled \"Mac OS X\". If SideStore then fails with -22410, open its Settings › User Customizations, tick \"Keep header customizations\" and tap Reset adi.pb.

apps.name: Nightflix
apps.subtitle: An iOS movie and series streaming app
apps.versionDescription:
Nightflix 3.0 is a complete redesign.

- New Netflix-style interface: Home with Series / Films / Categories filters, a featured title, Top 10 rows, Continue Watching and "Because You Watched" rows
- New & Hot tab: Coming Soon with release reminders, Everyone's Watching, and today's Top 10 series and films
- My Nightflix tab: Continue Watching, My List, titles you've rated, reminders and recently watched
- Tap a title for a quick preview, or open its full page with episodes, More Like This and trailers
- Search also finds titles by actor
- New built-in player (VidFast) with resume and episode autoplay
- The player opens in landscape and plays sound even with the silent switch on
